summary: Network-1 Technologies filed an 8-K reporting that its subsidiary voluntarily dismissed a patent infringement lawsuit against Jump Trading without prejudice. No financial terms, transaction details, or corporate actions are involved—this is purely a litigation update on an IP matter. There is no deal structure, recommendation, or event affecting capital structure. The filing is a routine current report on other events; the company may revisit IP claims based on future industry developments. No special situation category applies.
